Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a production 8-frame 2D walk-cycle sprite sheet for an existing original hand-painted game character.
Reference image role: EXACT CHARACTER IDENTITY AND STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target. It contains old idle and two walk poses. Redraw the SAME character into eight NEW sequential gait poses, keeping the face, hair/cap silhouette, short neck, torso/head proportions, clothing details/colors, chunky hands and black shoes. Do not reuse the two old walk poses eight times.
Layout: EXACTLY 8 separate full-body sprites in a regular 4-COLUMN by 2-ROW sheet, row-major reading order. Prefer canvas 2048x1024, eight equal 512x512 invisible cells. No grid lines, labels, numbering or cell outlines. Each sprite centered on a fixed torso axis at x=50% of its cell. Common planted-foot ground baseline at y=90% of each cell; common head-top reference near y=12%. Same character scale, head width and torso volume across ALL eight frames. Keep some blank margin inside every cell, no clipping, no overlap into neighbor cells. Background genuinely transparent RGBA, no shadow, ground, scenery, glow or UI.
Camera: EVERY sprite faces toward screen RIGHT, same mild elevated three-quarter game view as the reference. The face, nose and clothes face right in all frames; no turning toward camera or back. Mirror to left is done by runtime, not baked into this sheet.
Animation: a natural WALK IN PLACE, not running/hopping. Two steps per cycle, 8 phases at 12fps, eight actually different articulated leg/arm poses. Fixed identity/torso orientation, modest 1-2% vertical bob only. Feet on one common ground line when planted; raised foot clearly above that line. Both arms swing opposite their respective leg. Head does NOT rotate, grow/shrink or blur. The last phase naturally leads into the first.
Ordered phases, top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right:
0 CONTACT A: left leg extended forward toward RIGHT, left heel touches ground; right foot trailing with heel up. Right arm forward, left arm back. Wide stride, straight leading knee.
1 DOWN A: weight sinks onto left foot, left knee flexed; right rear toe starts lifting and trailing knee folds. Arms partway returning, visibly narrower stride than frame 0.
2 PASS A: left leg supports under hip, right knee and raised foot pass UNDER the torso. Arms close to vertical neutral. Feet nearly overlap horizontally but one is raised.
3 UP A: left support pushes from toe, right knee advances forward and up; right foot angled toes up preparing heel strike. Left arm swings forward. Distinct raised-knee silhouette.
4 CONTACT B: right heel strikes forward toward RIGHT, left foot trails with heel up. LEFT arm now swings forward across the near side and right arm swings back. Distinct near/far limb overlap from frame0.
5 DOWN B: weight on flexed right knee, left rear knee folds and left toe lifts; arms transition through opposite swing. Narrower than frame4, clearly different from frame1 due near/far leg layering.
6 PASS B: right leg supports below hip, left knee/raised foot passes under torso; arms close to neutral with reversed overlap compared to frame2.
7 UP B: right toe pushes off, left knee/foot move forward and upward preparing the next frame0 heel strike. Right arm approaches forward swing. Smooth wrap to frame0.
Constraints: eight unique anatomical poses, not duplicated silhouettes, not whole-body translation/rotation/warp, not dissolved/interpolated ghosts, not flipped character direction. Exactly two arms and two legs each. Maintain clean outlines and brush texture; no text, icons, symbols, numbers or watermark. No idle frame, no trails, no ghosting, no cast foot shadows or selected rings.

Identity: Actor 0: black spiky-haired slender-but-compact orange-clothed prisoner from reference. Keep EXACT spiky crown, nose, grin, orange collar/jumpsuit and blank cream name patch. Big head/hands/shoes and same shoulders; do not make him lanky or shrink his head.
